description: Launch 1/4: three-item permutation baseline eligibility for Qwen3-0.6B-Base. Kill task if overall acc < 95% or per-op acc < 90%.
scientific_question: Can Qwen3-0.6B-Base execute three-item permutations (rotate left, rotate right, reverse) at >= 95% accuracy with a fixed few-shot prompt? Eligibility gate for KV command-slot transplant experiment.
kill_condition: If either overall accuracy < 95% or any per-operation accuracy < 90%, kill the entire 4-launch program. No prompt repair.
